args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Essentials
- [ ] Passport and travel documents
- [ ] Travel insurance documents
- [ ] Credit cards and cash
- [ ] Power bank or portable charger
- [ ] Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- [ ] Beach towel and flip-flops
- [ ] Sunscreen with SPF 50+ (reapply every 2 hours)
- [ ] Waterproof phone case or dry bag

### Clothing
- [ ] Lightweight swimsuit
- [ ] Lightweight long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- [ ] Quick-dry shorts or pants
- [ ] Lightweight dress for evenings
- [ ] Comfortable walking shoes
- [ ] Sandals for beach

### Toiletries
- [ ] Travel-sized shampoo, conditioner, and body wash
- [ ] Toothbrush, toothpaste, and dental floss
- [ ] Deodorant
- [ ] Makeup and makeup remover
- [ ] Hair ties or clips
- [ ] Sunscreen
- [ ] Insect repellent

### Electronics
- [ ] Smartphone with charger
- [ ] Portable Wi-Fi hotspot (if needed)
- [ ] Camera or GoPro (optional)
- [ ] Headphones or earbuds

### Miscellaneous
- [ ] Travel adapter (if not already in possession)
- [ ] Travel-sized first-aid kit
- [ ] Emergency contact list
- [ ] Travel journal or notebook
- [ ] Snacks and water bottles

### Optional Add-Ons
- [ ] Waterproof bag for electronics
- [ ] Beach umbrella or shade
- [ ] Beach chair or lounge
- [ ] Snorkel mask and fins
- [ ] Waterproof phone case

### Notes
- Always pack a reusable water bottle to stay hydrated.
- Check the weather forecast for your travel dates.
- Consider packing a light jacket for cooler evenings or air-conditioned venues.
- Bring a reusable shopping bag for souvenirs and groceries.
- Double-check the packing list for any missing items based on your specific needs.
